# SQLMap

`sqlmap` &middot; _web-applications_

Tests whether a web parameter is vulnerable to SQL injection, and can prove it.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- A URL containing a parameter, e.g. https://target/item?id=1.
- Written authorisation to test the target.
- A reachable target; sqlmap is intrusive and will alter database state if it can.

## How to use it

Give it a URL with a parameter. SQLMap detects the injection type, the database engine, and (with more flags) enumerates data. Start with `--batch` so it does not prompt, and keep to `--level 1 --risk 1` first. Never point it at a site you do not own or have permission to test.

## Examples

```console
$ sqlmap -u 'https://example.com/item?id=1' --batch
$ sqlmap -u 'https://example.com/item?id=1' --dbs --batch
```
